question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: As of June 30, 2026, Raymond James reported total client assets under administration of $1.92 trillion (roughly $1,922 billion).
For the fiscal 2026 third quarter ended June 30, 2026, domestic Private Client Group net new assets were $21.7 billion, representing a 5.5% annualized growth rate.
items.quote: Domestic net new assets were $21.7 billion in the fiscal third quarter, representing a 5.5% annualized growth rate.

items.text: For the fiscal 2026 second quarter ended March 31, 2026, quarterly domestic net new assets were $23.0 billion, representing a 5.8% annualized growth rate.
items.quote: quarterly domestic net new assets were $23 billion, representing a 5.8% annualized growth rate.

items.text: For the fiscal 2026 first quarter ended December 31, 2025, domestic Private Client Group net new assets were $30.8 billion, or 8.0% annualized growth.
items.quote: Domestic Private Client Group net new assets of $30.8 billion for the fiscal first quarter, or annualized growth from beginning of the quarter assets of 8.0%

items.text: For the fiscal 2025 year ended September 30, 2025, domestic Private Client Group net new assets were $52.4 billion, or 3.8% growth from beginning of fiscal year assets.
items.quote: Fiscal year 2025, domestic Private Client Group net new assets of $52.4 billion, or 3.8% growth from the beginning of fiscal year assets

items.text: For the fiscal 2024 year ended September 30, 2024, domestic net new assets were $60.7 billion, representing a 5.5% growth rate on beginning period domestic Private Client Group assets.
items.quote: For the fiscal year, domestic net new assets were $60.7 billion, representing a 5.5% growth rate on beginning of the period Domestic Private Client Group assets.

items.text: Raymond James defines domestic Private Client Group net new assets as domestic PCG client inflows, including dividends and interest, less domestic PCG client outflows, including commissions, advisory fees, and other fees.
items.quote: Domestic Private Client Group net new assets represents domestic Private Client Group client inflows, including dividends and interest, less domestic Private Client Group client outflows, including commissions, advisory fees, and other fees.
items.definition: domestic Private Client Group client inflows, including dividends and interest, less domestic Private Client Group client outflows, including commissions, advisory fees, and other fees

items.text: As of September 30, 2025, the number of financial advisors increased compared to the prior year, and generally with planned retirements, assets are retained at the firm pursuant to advisor succession plans.
items.quote: Generally, with planned retirements, assets are retained at the firm pursuant to advisor succession plans.

items.text: For the year ended September 30, 2025, Raymond James' domestic financial advisor retention remained very strong.
items.quote: For the year ended September 30, 2025, our domestic financial advisor retention remained very strong.

items.text: For the fiscal 2026 first nine months, domestic net new assets of $75 billion were up 119% from the prior year, which was a record.
items.quote: So $75 billion of net new assets for the fiscal year is up 119% from last year, which was a record.

items.text: Over the 12 months ended March 31, 2025, Raymond James recruited financial advisors with approximately $50 billion of client assets at their previous firms (domestic independent contractor and employee channels).
items.quote: we recruited into our domestic independent contractor and employee channels financial advisors with approximately $316 million of trailing 12-month production and $50 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: In fiscal 2025, Raymond James had record recruiting of financial advisors to its domestic independent contractor and employee channels, with approximately $58 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.quote: These recruited advisors had approximately $58 billion of client assets at their previous firms, also surpassing last year's record.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels
